title: GSSK Model (Schema v4)
description:
Schema for General Systems Simulation Kernel (GSSK) models. Based on Odum's Energy Systems Language. Each inter-block connection carries four channels (Odum 2000, Appendix A): Code (carrier), Force (driving potential, implicit in logic+Q), Flow (rate, computed by logic), and Transformity (quality ratio, computed from quality_input).

This schema describes the PRE-EXPANSION model surface — what a consumer writes and hands to GSSK_Init. It is NOT the post-expansion vocabulary. Composite nodes (see Node.type) are expanded at GSSK_Init time into namespaced primitives, so the node set reported by GSSK_GetNodeID/GSSK_GetNodeTypeString after init is larger than, and typed differently from, the 'nodes' array here. In particular the post-expansion set can contain 'interaction' nodes that no model declared. Query membership with GSSK_GetNodeComposite/GSSK_GetNodeRole rather than parsing the '{instance}__{member}' id convention.

v4 adds the 'archetypes' block and composite node types. v3 added metadata versioning, snapshot support for deterministic replay, topology mutation logging, and multi-carrier declarations. v2 models auto-migrate to v3 with a warning.

Any property whose name begins with an underscore is permitted anywhere and ignored, both by this schema and by the kernel. See examples/household_model_annotated.json, which uses '_note' throughout.

nodes.description: Ordered array of compartments. For models with no composite nodes, the index of each node here is its column index in GSSK_GetState(). Composite nodes expand to several state columns, so once any composite is present, resolve indices with GSSK_FindNodeIdx() instead of assuming positional correspondence.

edges.description: Directed flows between nodes. Omit for a single isolated storage. An endpoint naming a composite instance resolves to that composite's declared 'in'/'out' port.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v4 supports the archetypes block and composite node types. v3 supports snapshot/mutation_log/carriers. v2 models auto-migrate to v3 with a warning. Any other value is rejected by GSSK_Init. Defaults to 3 when the metadata block is absent.

created_at.description: ISO8601 creation timestamp. Auto-generated if not provided.

kernel_version.description: Semver of GSSK kernel that created this model. Defaults to current kernel version at init time.

model_hash.description: SHA256 hex hash of the topology (nodes+edges) for reproducibility check. Auto-computed if not provided.

Archetypes.description: User-defined composite templates, keyed by archetype name. The key becomes a usable value for Node.type. User archetype names are registered after the four built-ins (producer, consumer, misc_box, system_frame) and may not exceed 32 archetypes in total. A user archetype whose name collides with a built-in shadows nothing — the built-in is found first.

ArchetypeDefn.description: One composite template. At expansion time each template node becomes a state node with id '{instance_id}__{template_node_id}', and each template edge becomes an edge with id '{instance_id}__{template_edge_id}'.

id.description: Internal id within the archetype namespace. Becomes the node's 'role' (GSSK_GetNodeRole).

value.description: Initial state. Overridden by the instance's 'value' for the node named by ports.in.

carrier.description: Odum Position 1 carrier label. Falls back to the instance's carrier if omitted.

edges.description: Template edges, wired between template node ids. Max 32 per archetype.

id.description: Internal edge id within the archetype namespace.

origin.description: Template node id the flow leaves.

target.description: Template node id the flow enters.

k.description: Conductance/rate coefficient. Defaults to 1.0 within archetype templates.

ports.description: Named external attachment points, mapping port name to internal template node id. The 'in' and 'out' ports are special: an external edge naming the composite instance as its target resolves to 'in', and as its origin resolves to 'out'. Without them the composite cannot be wired to the rest of the model, and the instance's declared 'value' is not applied to any member.

in.description: Template node id receiving inbound external flows.

out.description: Template node id supplying outbound external flows.

PrimitiveNodeType.description: A fundamental (non-composite) node type. storage: dQ/dt computed. source/constant: Q fixed at value. sink: accumulates inflows, not depleted. interaction/gain/loop_limited/exchange/switch: Phase 7 processing nodes, parameterised via the node 'params' block. NOTE: the kernel does not reject unrecognised type strings — parse_node_type() falls back to 'storage'. This enum is therefore advisory for authoring, not a description of what GSSK_Init will refuse.

Snapshot.description: State snapshot for deterministic replay, as emitted by GSSK_SerializeSnapshot.

dt.description: Time step in force at capture.

state.description: Live state keyed by post-expansion node id — one entry per state node, so composite members appear individually under their '{instance}__{member}' ids.

Tr.description: Transformity; 0.0 when quality accounting is disabled.

edge_k.description: Live conductance of every NAMED edge, including composite-internal edges (which are named '{instance}__{template_edge}'). Edges declared without an 'id' are omitted entirely, so this array is not positionally aligned with the model's 'edges' array.

rng_state.description: PRNG seed and live stream position for the stochastic entry points (GSSK_EnsembleForecast, GSSK_CalibrateMonteCarlo). Both are hex strings, not numbers: a uint64 exceeds the 53-bit exact-integer range of a JSON number. Restoring a snapshot restores both, so a stochastic result is reproducible from the snapshot alone. Null is accepted for snapshots written before seeding existed; the kernel then falls back to GSSK_DEFAULT_SEED.

seed.description: Seed last passed to GSSK_SetSeed. This is the value to pin in a run manifest.

state.description: Live SplitMix64 stream position. Differs from 'seed' once any draw has been taken.

MutationLog.description: Topology mutation history. Each entry records a successful AddNode/AddEdge/DeactivateEdge/DeactivateNode/SetEdgeK operation with causality.

t.description: Simulation time the mutation was applied.

target_id.description: Node or edge id the operation acted on.

payload.description: Operation-specific detail (e.g. the JSON fragment added).

Carriers.description: Multi-carrier type definitions. Each carrier can be conserved independently.

conserved.description: Whether this carrier obeys conservation law within isolated sub-systems.

Node.description: A compartment. Either a fundamental type (storage/source/sink/constant or a Phase 7 processing node) or a composite that expands at GSSK_Init time.

id.description: Unique identifier. Max 63 chars (C internal limit). Stable across model mutations. For composite nodes the id becomes the namespace prefix for expanded members, which truncates to 29 chars in member ids. An id may legitimately contain '__' — that does not make it a composite member.

type.description: Node type. One of: (a) a fundamental type — storage, source, sink, constant, interaction, gain, loop_limited, exchange, switch; (b) a built-in composite — producer (expands to body/gate/heat), consumer (body/heat), misc_box (box), system_frame (structural only, recorded as a single constant node); or (c) the name of any archetype declared in the top-level 'archetypes' block. Because (c) is open-ended this cannot be a closed enum. Unrecognised strings are NOT rejected — the kernel falls back to 'storage'.

value.description: Initial state Q at t_start, or fixed value for source/constant nodes. For a composite, this is applied to the member named by the archetype's 'in' port.

carrier.description: Odum Position 1 (Code) carrier label for this node. Metadata only; does not affect ODE integration. For a composite, applied to every expanded member that does not declare its own.

quality_input.description: Odum Position 4 (Transformity) at system boundary. Solar transformity convention: 1.0 for solar. Set on source/constant nodes to enable the quality accounting pass. Units are domain-defined (e.g. sej/J, sej/$, or dimensionless). Omit to disable quality accounting for this source.

output_mode.description: How quality propagates at bifurcations from this node. partition: quality divides proportionally to flow (Bastianoni split). replicate: each downstream branch receives the full quality (Bastianoni co-product). Does NOT affect ODE integration.

visual.description: UI layout hints. Ignored by the kernel.

NodeParams.description: Node-level parameters. The first four configure Phase 7 processing nodes; the remainder override internal edge conductances on built-in composites and are ignored on other node types.

C.description: Saturation constant for loop_limited nodes: F = k·Q/(1 + Q/C).

price.description: exchange: constant price — units of the money carrier per unit of the goods carrier. Used when price_node is absent or unresolvable. The transaction diamond applies F_money = price x F_goods to the money counter-flow.

price_node.description: exchange: id of a node whose current state supplies the price, making price a state variable rather than a constant. Takes precedence over price. May refer to a node declared later in the array — references are resolved in a second pass. This is what lets price be driven endogenously (e.g. by M/W) so inflation emerges rather than being dialled in by the author.

k_production.description: producer composites only: gain of the internal 'gate' interaction node. Default 0.01.

k_respiration.description: producer composites only: conductance of the internal body→heat 'resp' edge. Default 0.05.

k_metabolism.description: consumer composites only: conductance of the internal body→heat 'metab' edge. Default 0.1.

Edge.description:
A directed flow between two nodes. Implements Odum's four-position inter-block connection: carrier (Code), logic+Q (Force+Flow), quality_input on origin node (Transformity).

Only 'origin' and 'target' are unconditionally required. 'logic' and 'params.k' are required UNLESS the edge touches a Phase 7 processing node (interaction, gain, loop_limited, exchange, switch), in which case logic defaults to 'linear' and k defaults to 1.0. That condition depends on the types of the referenced nodes, which JSON Schema cannot resolve, so both fields are declared optional here and the rule is enforced by GSSK_Init.

id.description: Stable identifier. Required for GSSK_SetEdgeK(), GSSK_DeactivateEdge(), and coupled_edge references.

origin.description: ID of the node the flow leaves. May name a composite instance, resolving to its 'out' port.

target.description: ID of the node the flow enters. May name a composite instance, resolving to its 'in' port.

carrier.description: Odum Position 1 (Code): what substance or entity is flowing. Free string — use domain conventions: 'energy', 'money', 'material', 'information', 'force', or specific types ('H2O', 'GBP', 'bits'). Does NOT affect ODE integration. Used by quality accounting pass and UI.

output_mode.description: Quality propagation mode for this specific edge. Overrides the origin node's output_mode for this edge only.

coupled_edge.description: ID of a paired counter-flow edge. Used to model commodity-payment pairs where money flows opposite to goods (e.g. 'salary_payment' coupled with 'labour_delivery'). Kernel uses this for quality accounting directionality.

visual.description: UI layout hints. Ignored by the kernel.

EdgeLogic.description:
Flow calculation type. Encodes Odum Position 2 (Force) and Position 3 (Flow) jointly. Unlike node types, an unrecognised logic string IS rejected by GSSK_Init.

ratio: F = k x Q_origin / max(Q_control, epsilon) — division, requiring params.control_node as the denominator. The denominator is floored so the flow saturates rather than diverging as the control approaches zero; params.threshold sets that floor when above zero, otherwise GSSK_RATIO_EPSILON (1e-9) applies. A model whose control rides the floor is reporting a saturated constant, not a quotient.

k.description: Conductance/rate coefficient. Modifiable at runtime via GSSK_SetEdgeK(). For constant logic: flow = k. For linear: flow = k × Q_origin. Required unless the edge touches a Phase 7 processing node, where it defaults to 1.0.

control_node.description: Required for interaction and limit logic. ID of the node whose Q value modulates the flow.

threshold.description: Required for threshold logic. Flow = k if Q_origin > threshold, else 0.

Config.description: Simulation parameters. All fields optional — defaults shown.

t_end.description: Simulation end time. Must be > t_start.

method.description: Integration method. auto: kernel selects incipient where eligible (all-constant/linear/interaction edges), RK4 otherwise, with dual-solver verification. euler/rk4: force specific solver (debugging). incipient: force IDC (testing only — falls back to RK4 for limit/threshold edges).

solver_tolerance.description: Maximum relative error between IDC and RK4 before dual-solver confidence degrades to DEGRADED and k-adjustments are frozen. Only used in auto mode.
